content_sections.heading: WCD Mahasamund Notification PDF 2026

The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Mahasamund notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: The multi-purpose activity could be outsourced to any person who is literate with knowledge / experience of working in the relevant domain. High School pass or equivalent will be preferred. Experience: Knowledge / experience of working in the relevant domain Age limit: Not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years; maximum 45 years including all (as on 01 January of the year of selection) Age relaxation: All relaxations combined (as per State Government instructions) Maximum age not more than 45 years Other conditions: The post is for an unreserved woman candidate Knowledge of the local language / dialect is essential Non-conviction certificate must be submitted with the application Employees of government / semi-government bodies must submit the employer's NOC, otherwise the application will not be considered Voluntary service certificates are not accepted as experience Desirable: High School pass or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for WCD Mahasamund Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A candidate who married before the minimum legal age for marriage A candidate who married a person already having a living spouse, unless the Government grants exemption

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment for a maximum of 2 years initially on consolidated service fee Extension of 1 year at a time may be decided by the District Collector Appointment is purely temporary and may be ended with one month's notice or one month's pay Posts last only as long as the Government of India runs the scheme Governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965 Medical fitness certificate within 1 month of selection; police verification before appointment

content_sections.heading: How Will WCD Mahasamund Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list out of 80 marks based on qualification percentage and experience Eligible / ineligible list, claims and objections Preference list in 1:10 ratio Walk-in interview / skill test of 20 marks Up to 60 marks with 100-mark weightage on percentage in the minimum qualification 2 marks per extra year of experience beyond the minimum, up to 10 marks Merit list of 80 marks; walk-in interview / skill test of 20 marks Tie in merit broken by seniority in age

content_sections.heading: WCD Mahasamund Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 10th mark sheet / certificate for date of birth 12th and graduation mark sheets Post-graduation mark sheet and professional course certificate, if required for the post Experience certificate attested by a Gazetted Officer and NOC (if applicable) Chhattisgarh residence certificate and non-conviction certificate Recent self-attested passport-size photograph pasted on the form

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCD Mahasamund Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format printed with the notice. Attach certificates and mark sheets attested by a Gazetted Officer or self-attested. Paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph on the form. Appear in person at the Office of the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Mahasamund on 04-12-2026. Submit the application in person during registration, 09:00 to 11:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only applications submitted in person at the office on 04-12-2026 will be accepted No travelling or other allowance for attending the walk-in interview Incomplete, unclear or erroneous applications will be rejected without intimation Post name, full correspondence address, email and mobile number must be written on the form Selected candidate must keep victims' data confidential and give an affidavit to that effect Detailed information is on the office notice board and https://mahasamund.gov.in

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Mahasamund Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Mahasamund Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Multi-purpose Helper / Cook.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Mahasamund Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years; maximum 45 years including all (as on 01 January of the year of selection). Relaxation: All relaxations combined (as per State Government instructions) Maximum age not more than 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated service fee of Rs. 11,720 (Level-2).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Literate with knowledge / experience of working in the relevant domain; High School pass or equivalent will be preferred.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The post is for an unreserved woman candidate. Knowledge of the local language / dialect is essential. Non-conviction certificate must be submitted with the application. Employees of government / semi-government bodies must submit the employer's NOC, otherwise the application will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A candidate who married before the minimum legal age for marriage. A candidate who married a person already having a living spouse, unless the Government grants exemption.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list out of 80 marks based on qualification percentage and experience. Eligible / ineligible list, claims and objections. Preference list in 1:10 ratio. Walk-in interview / skill test of 20 marks.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment for a maximum of 2 years initially on consolidated service fee. Extension of 1 year at a time may be decided by the District Collector. Appointment is purely temporary and may be ended with one month's notice or one month's pay.
